spec.title: HTTP Server
spec.description: Requests handled by the application, by route, status, and duration, following the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

spec.name: instance
spec.label: Instance
spec.description: Application instances, from the most recently started.

spec.title: Requests
spec.description: Requests handled in the selected time range.

spec.title: Error Rate
spec.description: Share of the requests answered with a server error (5xx) in the selected time range.

spec.expr: (sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Client Errors
spec.description: Requests answered with a client error (4xx) in the selected time range, such as unknown routes or invalid input.

spec.title: Average Duration
spec.description: Average duration of the requests in the selected time range.

spec.title: Longest Request
spec.description: Duration of the longest request in the selected time range.

spec.title: Active Requests
spec.description: Requests in progress right now, for all routes.

spec.title: Routes
spec.description: Requests, error rate, and durations by route in the selected time range. Select a column header to sort.

spec.expr: (sum by (http_route) (label_replace(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", "")) or sum by (http_route) (label_replace(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__range]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", "")) * 0) / sum by (http_route) (label_replace(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__range]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", ""))

sum by (http_route) (label_replace(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__range]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", "")) / sum by (http_route) (label_replace(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__range]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", ""))

spec.title: Requests by Status
spec.description: Requests per second, by class of status code.

spec.title: Server Errors
spec.description: Requests per second answered with a server error (5xx), by route and status code.

spec.title: Client Errors
spec.description: Requests per second answered with a client error (4xx), by route and status code.

spec.expr: sum by (http_route) (label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", "")) / sum by (http_route) (label_replace(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", instance="$instance", http_route=~"$target"}[$__rate_interval]), "http_route", "UNKNOWN", "http_route", ""))

spec.title: Longest Request
spec.description: Duration of the longest request, by route.

spec.title: Failed Requests
spec.description: The most recent requests answered with a server error (5xx). Select a span to see its trace.
